name: agents-trust
description: Find a paid API for a task: ranked x402-paid APIs with price, payment network, invocation details and live payment-challenge evidence. Quotes without a wallet; pays only with your own wallet under your own cap.

evm_private_key.title: Base wallet private key (optional)
evm_private_key.description: Leave empty for quote-only mode: the recommend tool then never pays. If set, it pays the Agents Trust fee in USDC on Base from this wallet, up to the caps below. Use a dedicated hot wallet with a small balance.

max_fee_usdc.title: Max fee per query (USDC)
max_fee_usdc.description: The highest Agents Trust fee the tool may sign for one query. The fee is currently 0.01 USDC; the cap leaves room for a price change.

max_total_usdc.title: Max total spend while running (USDC)
max_total_usdc.description: The most the tool may spend in total before the server restarts.
